title: Identifying Latent Causal Structure with Multi-State Latents under Double Triangular Measurements
banked_reason: Stage 0.5 typed BELOW NOVELTY FLOOR: the maximized exact-population identification note is subfield tier with ceiling 6.8 below the fixed field floor and is not salvageable in scope.
gap_reasons: The cdmTools consumer remains only a population specification: the algorithm relies on exact equality, rank, and conditional-independence queries, while multiplicity-calibrated finite-sample inference is left open.
proof_attempt_summary: The run derived a sound exact-population package: rectangular Gram-certificate sufficiency, an equal-q iff frontier, generic nonvanishing, q^K latent-state and K_min bounds, exact three-view coordinate/MEC recovery, and a terminating exhaustive exact-real reconstruction. The proposed heterogeneous necessity direction was refuted by a strictly positive counterexample and honestly narrowed. The surviving package remained subfield because it supplied no calibrated finite-sample certificate, practical implementation, complexity analysis, or reproducible consumer demonstration; the three listed review findings remain unrepaired, so this is an unrepaired draft.
tldr: The headline result is a terminating exact-real algorithm \(A_q\) for \(q\ge3\) latent states and heterogeneous finite responses with \(m_j\ge q\).  A product of local Gram determinants \(c_{a,k,u}=\det(L_{a,k,u}^{\mathsf T}L_{a,k,u})\) certifies full column rank of two rectangular triangular views, exact three-view recovery supplies \(q^K\) anonymous components, and the observable equality lattice aligns them with \(K\) categorical coordinates and a latent MEC.  The two-view rank also forces every finite latent measurement representation to have at least \(q^K\) joint states and gives \(K_{\min}(P_X)=K\).  In the equal-\(q\) case the original determinant product remains an exact if-and-only-if frontier.  That converse cannot extend to all larger alphabets: a strictly positive \(q=3\) witness has a singular earlier local table but a full-rank rectangular view.  The dense ternary no-pure-child witness remains an exact regression fixture, and the sole open rung is finite-sample multiplicity calibration for a \(\texttt{cdmTools}\)-style diagnostic.
gap: Binary double triangularity uses scalar contrasts, whereas for \(q\ge3\) ordinary nondegeneracy permits a local conditional determinant to vanish. Generic Kruskal theory neither locates the failing graph context nor aligns its \(q^K\) anonymous mixture labels with \(K\) categorical coordinates and a latent MEC. Chen et al. (2025) restore tensor rank through completeness and two larger-support or continuous sufficient measurements, conditions that do not cover equal-\(q\) tables.
fill: The project delivers a field-tier exact determinant frontier, an intrinsic latent-dimension theorem, an explicit coordinate-alignment theorem that upgrades anonymous \(q^K\) mixture labels to \(K\) categorical coordinates and a latent MEC, fixed-dimension quotient identification over an enumerated alternative domain, a dense positive ternary witness with displayed matrices, and a concrete recovery handle for CDM diagnostics.
